verdict.rationale: mParticle's own docs show it builds audiences for activation: audience creation is a documented step before connecting outputs, there are Audiences and Composable Audiences guides, and marketing copy says users can describe an audience and have mParticle suggest the logic. None of this shows a visual, no-SQL builder over traits and behavior, or any audience size estimate before activation. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a visual trait/behavior builder with no SQL, a pre-activation audience size estimate, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
